title: The Cup That Stayed Warm
story: In the village of Brindle, an old cup sat on the inn table. It stayed warm only when a drink was shared. If someone drank alone, the tea turned cold at once. A girl named Nia poured a full cup on a cold evening. A traveller came in with wet boots and no drink. Nia pushed the cup toward him and asked him to take half. The tea grew hot again, and a soft gold light rose from the cup. The owner smiled and explained the rule. The cup was not a trick for guests to fear. It reminded the village that comfort should be shared. Nia and the traveller talked until their boots were dry. Before he left, he poured a fresh cup and offered it back to her. The light returned, and the inn felt kind. Nia washed the cup each week so the glow was easy to see.

quiz.question: In this story, what does glow mean?

quiz.question: Why did the light come back before the traveller left?
options: He shared a fresh cup with Nia
Nia finished a full cup alone
The owner hid the cup away
The tea stayed cold on the table
quiz.correctAnswer: He shared a fresh cup with Nia
quiz.explanation: He offered Nia a fresh cup, and the light returns when a drink is shared.
quiz.supportingSentence: Before he left, he poured a fresh cup and offered it back to her.
